scripts.dev: bun run --bun concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "bun run --bun --cwd apps/api dev" "bun run --bun --cwd apps/web dev"
scripts.build: bun run --bun --cwd packages/contracts build && bun run --bun --cwd apps/api build && bun run --bun --cwd apps/web build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --bun --cwd packages/contracts build && bun run --bun --cwd apps/api typecheck && bun run --bun --cwd apps/web typecheck
